In Uma Musume/Japanese racing, 重赏 denotes the graded-race category (G1/G2/G3), not a literal 'heavy reward'. Global/community player-facing English consistently calls these graded races. Keep the canonical alias as the modifier 'graded' so it composes naturally with the project's generic Cuộc đua label in longer Vietnamese strings.
